meta.name: deal-outreach
meta.description: Cold outbound sequence builder — produces multi-touch email + LinkedIn sequences (5-7 touchpoints) personalized by persona type (technical buyer, economic buyer, champion). Use when asked to "write cold emails", "build an outbound sequence", "create prospecting emails", "write my LinkedIn outreach", or "design a cold email campaign".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成多触点的冷外联序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量构建个性化邮件和LinkedIn外联序列
copy.tagline_en: Build personalized multi-touch cold outreach sequences automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to craft multi-channel outbound sequences tailored by buyer persona

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的人物类型（经济买家、技术买家或拥护者），生成一套包含6个触点的邮件和LinkedIn消息序列，每个触点有指定时机和内容。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude“写冷邮件”、“构建外呼序列”、“创建潜在客户邮件”、“写LinkedIn推广”或“设计冷邮件活动”时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一套冷邮件序列，针对技术买家。
say.note: Claude会生成6封邮件，突出技术细节和集成等。

say.text: 为经济买家设计一个6触点的LinkedIn序列。
say.note: Claude会结合LinkedIn请求和消息，聚焦商业成果。

say.text: 我想为一位经理级用户构建冷外呼序列。
say.note: Claude会生成针对拥护者角色的序列，强调解决问题。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a cold outbound sequence builder that produces multi-touch email + LinkedIn sequences (6 touches) personalized by persona type (economic buyer, technical buyer, champion).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to "write cold emails", "build an outbound sequence", "create prospecting emails", "write my LinkedIn outreach", or "design a cold email campaign".

say_en.text: Write a cold email sequence for a technical buyer.
say_en.note: Claude generates 6 emails highlighting technical details and integration.

say_en.text: Design a 6-touch LinkedIn sequence for an economic buyer.
say_en.note: Claude combines LinkedIn requests and messages focusing on business outcomes.

say_en.text: Build a cold outreach sequence for a champion persona.
say_en.note: Claude produces a sequence emphasizing problem-solving for managers/ICs.
